body:
# The BassetBlocks Creator Modpack

The **BassetBlocks Creator** modpack is a comprehensive collection of client-side mods and resource packs specifically curated for Minecraft content creators. It is built to provide a stable, high-performance foundation using optimization mods like **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore**, ensuring smooth gameplay for recording and streaming.

The pack features powerful cinematic tools such as **ReplayMod**, **Flashback**, and **Camera Utils**, allowing for sophisticated recording and editing. It also enhances the creative workflow with utility mods like **Litematica** for schematics and **Armor Poser** for scene setup. Visuals are significantly upgraded through resource packs like **Fresh Animations** and a wide array of VanillaTweaks collections, which add detail, consistency, and utility to the game's appearance. Finally, social and multiplayer features like **Simple Voice Chat** and **Status** are included to facilitate collaboration and community interaction.

### Easy Customization

  - **Before Launch:** You can decide exactly what your experience will be like using the **Modrinth App**. Just go to your modpack's content list and use the simple toggles to turn any mod on or off for that session. Once you're happy with your selection, you hit "Play."![Modrinth App Toggle Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f03d7bbce57c2b3eb2fb14dca8c7e0951b7cdfc0.png)
  - **In-Game Menu:** When you get to the main menu, the **Mod Menu** mod adds a "Mods" button to your options screen. This is your in-game command center. From here, you can click on any mod and, if it has a gear icon, dive into its specific settings to tweak it to your liking.![Configure Mod Setting In Game With Mod Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d38fa77b590b5f32eca7e3f59ee97194f4d5fcd2.png)
  - **Deeper Integration:** For even deeper customization, **VTDownloader** integrates directly into that same Mod Menu. Open its configuration screen, and you can browse and install any VanillaTweaks resource pack or data pack you want, all without ever leaving the game.![Download VT Resources In Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9a20de8f7be8dc2c2f3b18dd4982445dda1d8c1.png)

## Our Purpose

The three BassetBlocks Modpacks—**Core**, **Community**, and **Creator**—are a user-friendly solution designed to simplify the process of installing and managing the mods, datapacks, and resource packs for use on the BassetBlocks server. Our purpose is to ensure all players, regardless of their technical expertise, can easily get started on the server with the correct and most current mods, eliminating the frustration of manual installation and versioning. The modpacks make it simple to stay updated with every Minecraft release, allowing you to focus on what matters most—playing on the BassetBlocks server.

> ### Tired of the hassle?
>
> Tired of the complicated, time-consuming process of manually installing mods, datapacks, and resource packs just to play on the BassetBlocks server? The BassetBlocks Modpacks are here to help. With a single click using the Modrinth App, you can get everything you need to jump into the action. No more searching for individual mods, dealing with compatibility issues, or struggling with updates. The modpack is built for convenience, making sure you have a seamless experience from the moment you launch Minecraft.

## The BassetBlocks Modpack Collection

### BassetBlocks: Core

The **BassetBlocks: Core** modpack is the essential modpack required to connect and play on the BassetBlocks server. It contains the absolute minimum of mods needed for core gameplay mechanics and performance, ensuring a smooth and stable experience. If you are new to the server or prefer a lightweight, vanilla-plus experience, this is the perfect place to start.

### BassetBlocks: Community

Building upon the Core modpack, the **BassetBlocks: Community** modpack is the recommended choice for the definitive BassetBlocks experience. It includes all essential mods plus a curated selection of popular, player-requested additions that enhance gameplay with quality-of-life features, aesthetic blocks, and visual tweaks. This pack is perfect for players who want to enjoy everything the server community has to offer.

### BassetBlocks: Creator

Designed specifically for streamers and video producers, the **BassetBlocks: Creator** modpack is the all-in-one solution for content creation. It includes everything from the Core and Community modpacks, plus powerful client-side tools for recording, creating cinematic shots, and managing your visual presentation. If you plan on sharing your BassetBlocks adventures with an audience, this pack provides all the tools you need.

### BassetBlocks: ServerSide

This is a modpack collection for server administration purposes only and should **not** be downloaded by players. It contains all the necessary backend mods, datapacks, and configuration files that run the BassetBlocks world, manage performance, and provide support for player-side features. This pack runs exclusively on the server to make the magic happen for everyone. The modpack is available for admins that want to set up a server similar to BassetBlocks.

-----

## What's Inside?

### Key Mods for Creators

  * **Cinematic Tools:** Record, replay, and create stunning camera shots with **ReplayMod**, **Flashback**, and **Camera Utils**. Includes **Replay Voice Chat** for full audio capture.
  * **Creative Utilities:** Plan and execute complex builds with **Litematica**, get detailed information with **MiniHUD**, customize game mechanics with **Tweakeroo**, and set up scenes perfectly with **Armor Poser**.
  * **Performance:** Get the smoothest recording experience possible with a full suite of optimization mods, including **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, and **Bobby**.
  * **Quality of Life & Visuals:** See recipes with **REI**, map your world with **JourneyMap**, get realistic **Sound Physics Remastered**, and see inside containers with **Peek**.
  * **Social:** Collaborate and interact with your community using **Simple Voice Chat**, **Chat Heads**, and the **Status** mod.

### Key Resource Packs

  * **Animations & Models:** Bring your world to life with the incredible mob animations of **Fresh Animations** and add depth to your builds with **3D Textures**.
  * **Visual Polish:** Create a more dynamic and consistent look with block **Variations**, **More Zombies**, and a collection of **Fixes and Consistency** tweaks.
  * **Utility & UI:** Get a cleaner interface with the **GUI** pack and clear visual cues for **Farming**, **Mining**, and **Redstone**.
  * **Sound:** Enjoy a more peaceful recording environment with the **Quieter Sounds** pack.
